source_file: Clin Pharma and Therapeutics - 2026 - Hartauer - Integrated assessment of rifampicin‐mediated induction of transporters and.pdf
source_type: original in vitro experimental/translational pharmacology study using a human liver tissue chip
extraction_limitations: The paper reports supplementary information, but no companion supplementary material was listed or supplied for Task 13; supplement-dependent methods/tables/figures were not invented.
The study used technical replicates and three PHH donors; sample-size fields are populated only where the primary source supplied an exact chip n that could be represented without inference.
Standard-deviation notation from Table 1 is preserved in canonical/original-result text because the LiteratureAtom interval model does not define standard deviation as an interval type.
Figure-derived atoms report source fold changes but do not infer clinical induction magnitude or in vivo DDI consequences.
